page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.g5.2xlarge primarily in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench fall into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth tests show a split profile, with small-block cached reads registering in the bottom 25% at 328.71 GB/sec, while large-block uncached reads and writes achieve average tier results at 40.9 GB/sec and 35.94 GB/sec respectively. Passmark CPU tests yield an average score of 7041.88, though database operations and encryption tests remain weak.

Given the lack of local storage and the weak performance in database operations and Redis SET operations, this instance is less suited for high-throughput database workloads. It is capable of handling lightweight general-purpose tasks, basic web serving, and small-scale LLM inference, where it achieves average speeds of 117.62 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M model. However, performance drops significantly to poor levels on larger 7B models.

It operates on the KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates generally weak performance, with stress-ng and Geekbench CPU scores falling into the bottom 25%. While large-block memory bandwidth and small-model LLM inference perform at average levels, more intensive tasks like database operations, Redis SET operations, and larger LLM inference show poor to weak results. This instance is best suited for moderate general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight application hosting that do not require high-speed local storage or intensive multi-threaded compute capabilities.
